outline: This course aims to prepare graduate students in applied linguistics to critically evaluate published research in their field and to design their own research studies. The course covers a range of theoretical, practical, and ethical issues in applied linguistics research. It examines principles for undertaking empirical research, introduces popular quantitative and qualitative methods for conducting small-scale research, and provides hands-on experience with research design, instruments for data collection, quantitative and qualitative methods of data analysis, evaluation of published research, and research report writing.
